judgment_calls: Lime rake uses a solid upright iron draw-blade (rake-out hoe) on a 2.0 m pole, no tines, to differ from the 5-tine charcoal rake
Kiln door blank is a stone slab on a sill with iron straps, upright - not a plank damper like the charcoal vent cover
Quicklime is chalk-white lumps in a pale lime-dusted sack, 7-seg lathe to stay under budget
Slaking trough is a rectangular plank trough on skids with lime putty and a paddle - not a round tub/vat
